svg.text: Real-time fraud scoring with the full model lifecycle on a Talos Kubernetes homelab. Solid arrows: requests and data. Dashed: control and metadata.
PSI of the last hour of features
Every workload: ServiceMonitor or PodMonitor, non-root, read-only root filesystem, probes, requests and limits.
One trainer image runs training Jobs, the retrain CronJob, the drift monitor and the registry exporter.
scrapes every fraud workload; Fraud* alerts
Also platform: Rook-Ceph storage, MetalLB, Talos.
Secrets are created by hand, never in Git.
